mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially increasing albuterol metabolism via alternative pathways and increasing systemic exposure; both agents have sympathomimetic and cardiac effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased albuterol side effects (tremor, tachycardia, arrhythmias); consider alternative antibiotic if cardiac effects emerge; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical observation is warranted.
